name: Rohan Desai
stood_out: Ran a warehouse-management rollout at a 3PL for two years before moving into engineering leadership. Described, unprompted, what a dispatch clerk's morning looks like.
interview: Walked through a migration he aborted three weeks in after the pilot branch's numbers did not move. Took the reversal to the client himself.
outcome: Strongest technical hire to date; sets the bar for the team.
